BiblicalUsage: Obil was an Ishmaelite set over David's camels, named once among the officers of the king's household, alongside the keepers of the vineyards and the olive trees. He kept the camels of the king, a trust given to an Ishmaelite in the heart of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Obil is the proof that God uses outsiders: an Ishmaelite was put over David's camels, and his name is written among the officers of the king.
